definition.value: AI Chat Assistant
AI Chat Assistant enables customers to quickly find and select from a pre-populated list of results as they type. Now with Groq AI integration for natural language search and configurable keywords.

🚫 Generic Words to AVOID: Comma-separated list of generic words that will be filtered out from searches because they are too general (e.g., product, item, thing, cheap, expensive). The AI will ignore these words to focus on specific product terms. You can customize this list based on your business type.

✅ Support Keywords to SUGGEST: Comma-separated list of helpful keywords that will be suggested when customers write generic greetings like "hello" or when no specific keywords are found. These appear as clickable suggestions to help customers find common store information (e.g., contact, shipping, returns, faq).
Chat Interface Color Theme: Choose a color scheme that matches your store's branding. The chat panel, buttons, and gradients will adapt to the selected theme. Changes apply immediately after saving.#

AI Temperature: Controls creativity. 0.1 = direct answers, 0.7 = creative responses.#
Max Tokens: Maximum response length. Higher values = more detailed responses but slower.#
Cache Duration (seconds): How long to cache AI responses.#
Natural Language Threshold: Minimum words to trigger AI processing. Queries with fewer words use traditional search.#
